messages.subject: Plot raster in real time
parts:
Hello,
I am trying to take raster input (from fileInput()), and plot after it has been read. I am very new to R Shiny (as of this morning), so any advice would be helpful. I am confused as how to make the plot reactive to the raster input. This is what I have so far:

ui <- fluidPage(pageWithSidebar(
 
  headerPanel("Multispectral Calibration"),
  sidebarPanel(
   
    fileInput("datasetNIR", "Browse NIR Raster"),
  ),
 
  mainPanel(

    plotOutput(outputId = "datasetNIRplot")
   
  )
))

##########################################
server<-function(input,output){
 
  #test<-reactive(raster(input$datasetNIR))
 
  output$datasetNIRplot <- renderPlot({
    data<-raster(input$datasetNIR)
    plot(data)
  })
 
}

######################################
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
